svg.aria-label: Nonlinear pendulum (blue) against its linearization about θ = 0 (pink dashed), for a = Mgl/2J = 9.8 and no torque. From θ(0) = 0.3 rad the two agree closely. From θ(0) = 2.5 rad the nonlinear pendulum swings much more slowly and the linear model is wrong
svg.title: Nonlinear pendulum (blue) against its linearization about θ = 0 (pink dashed), for a = Mgl/2J = 9.8 and no torque. From θ(0) = 0.3 rad the two agree closely. From θ(0) = 2.5 rad the nonlinear pendulum swings much more slowly and the linear model is wrong

g.text: blue: nonlinear θ″ = −a sin θ pink dashed: linear θ″ = −a θ
